messages:
Nadia: short note 99999999we're seeing partner claim disputes for Fortune 200 accounts. Need a short SLA for escalation + evidence requirements.
Omar: agreed. what evidence do we need? intro email thread? signed NDA?
Becky: minimum: partner-provided intro email to customer, timestamped activity in partner portal, any POC SOW draft. Prefer 3 items.
Nadia: SLA idea: disputes must be raised within 14 days of initial claim or flagged purchase, Partnerships team will respond within 3 business days and decide within 10 business days.
partnerships-bot: created task: partner-dispute-sla, due_in: 14d.
legal-bot: reminder: any shared customer logos or co-marketing requires signed MOU.
Omar: sounds reasonable. also recommend storing claim metadata (IP, contact person, first outreach) as immutable record on intake.
Becky: action items: Becky draft SLA + evidence checklist, Omar add intake metadata fields, Nadia own escalation path doc.
Nadia: will loop in sales-ops to update SF duplicate field mapping.
Omar: propose we tag high-risk accounts with "cust_dispute_risk" boolean so claims require manual check.
Becky: good call. also add partner-reputation score to tiebreaker.
Nadia: ok rolling this into the main dedupe policy. thanks team.
